route_title: Selective cavity-layer tuning in 16-layer ZnSe/ZnS dual-band IR filter
compilation_rationale: Bounded 16-layer ZnSe/ZnS stack on Ge optimized for mid-IR transmission. Three tunable layers constrained to narrow bounds while others remain fixed at seed thicknesses. Targeting broad high-transmittance passband (8000–11000 nm) and suppressed leakage (3000–5000 nm) under coherent plane-wave illumination at normal incidence.
